method: Exact signed PE files inspected with repository Capstone/pefile tools; Ghidra requests timed out

layout_reviews.observation: MOVECHAN move-up and move-down helpers test the selected byte on channels resolved from the rack-filter list. These are selection-dependent reorder operations, not unrelated aggregate-offset votes.

The MOVECHAN refresh helper walks channels, reads their grid pointer and updates its UI state. These three sites correspond to the reviewed reference sites 0xf507a1, 0xf5140c and 0xf514e4 using 0x7bc.
BUSYBEGIN receives the main form in RCX, tests its busy object and stores the newly created object at 0x2f14.
NOTEARR indexes by 2*9*8=0x90 and accesses the note-array object at +0x28. Its direct table base 0x1558af8 equals the qword stored in mapped PATARR global 0x143d2b8.
MOVECHAN dereferences mapped playlist form global then loads +0xcc0 and calls mapped PATREFRESH on that object.
MARKREFRESH remaps selected-marker indices at +0xd18 after record swaps. FORMADDMARK receives the marker-list address at +0xd10, selects a new index and later clears selection to -1.
Published TimePanelMouseDown reads a signed scroll dword at +0xae4, adds mouse x and multiplies by the double ticks-per-pixel at +0xad4.
Published TimeScrollerPaintKnob chooses playlist/piano grids at +0xcb8/+0xc00. VZoomSelectChange independently identifies the playlist grid and uses grid vertical scroll +0x3f8 in both branches.
MUTE forms track*555*4=track*0x8ac; a separate full-track loop increments by 0x8ac. Enabled remains the byte at +0x18.
MIXNAME iterates ten effect pointers at track+0x75c+slot*8; SETROUTE independently reads the same slot base.
SETROUTE forms source-track record+0x2e4, advances by destination*8 and reads/writes enabled at route+4.
REC dereferences mapped MAINFORM and immediately dereferences its +0xf38 object before reading +0x47e. fl_ready must check +0xf38 on this build; existing +0xf30 is not the object consumed by REC.

Unique match of entire 22-byte reference key-to-y routine 0xd8c3b0 after masking only the three known field displacements: (topkey-key)*keyheight-vscroll. FL24 fields are +0x3d4,+0x510,+0x3f8; there is no uniform field shift.

Published PrevPresetBtnClick and KeyboardFocusBtnClick pass form+0x45c as the handle to the same Win32-style message wrapper, using message IDs 0x54d and 0x54f. The existing HWND field remains unchanged.
Pattern name remains +0, color +8, marker-list address +0x30.
PLTRACK indexes tracks by (16+1)*4+1=69 then times4, giving stride0x114; name is +0x24 and color is name-pointer-base+8=track+0x2c.

abi_reviews.name: MOVECHAN
observations: Captures object RCX, mode EDX, argument R8D and flags R9B before nested calls.
Dispatches low16 mode values1..5 to sort/move helpers; modes4/5 call the independently reviewed channel-selection move-up/down helpers.

Rebuilds the channel list, refreshes channels and playlist pattern controls, matching existing reorder semantics. Existing code passes modes4/5 and byte flags1; full EDX use does not alter these values.

abi_reviews.name: SAVEPROJ
observations: Captures path RCX and flag DL; later passes that path to mapped SAVEPRESET with mask0, object0 and saved flag as the fourth argument.
Returns a byte result from [rbp+0x2f] at0x107a76d. Published SaveMenuClick at0x108b5e0 calls this function at0x108bafc.
The protected region after0x107a519 is not established by linear decoding; the ABI and project-save use sites support the mapping, not complete deobfuscation.

abi_reviews.name: PLTRACK
observations: Captures arrangement RCX, track EDX, color R9D and UnicodeString name R8.
Writes the name at arrangement+track*0x114+0x24 and color at+0x2c; also updates linked channel or mixer metadata. Existing four-argument ABI is supported.

abi_reviews.name: MARKADD
observations: Captures marker-list address RCX, position EDX, action R9D, UnicodeString name R8. Reads fifth and sixth stack-byte arguments at RBP+0x70/+0x78 (entry RSP+0x28/+0x30).
Extends the array via mapped DYNSETLEN; record arithmetic gives0x34, then position/action/name at0/4/8 and time-signature data at0x10. FORMADDMARK independently forwards all six arguments.

abi_reviews.name: MSGBOX
observations: Preserves text RCX, flags EDX and callback R8, then passes them to the dialog initializer and returns the dialog result.
The first12 bytes exactly match existing mode2 guard: push r13/rdi/rsi/rbx; sub rsp,0x38; mov rbx,rcx. None are position-dependent; byte12 resumes at mov esi,edx (0xa7f92c).
Existing mode2 trampoline copies only whole instructions and can resume at+12 without operand relocation. No runtime hook or dialog behavior was tested here.

abi_reviews.name: SETPROJ
observations: Captures form RCX, first path RDX, second path R8 and addRecent R9B after the large stack-probe setup.
Assigns UnicodeString globals0x1512e68 and mapped PROJNAME0x1512e70 through the standard string assignment helper.
Calls published UpdatePathLabels0x1213970 and gates recent-project logic on the captured addRecent flag.

Independent published callers RenameProjectBtnClick0x120aab0 and ProjDataPathBtnClick0x1214cf0 invoke this function at0x120b2da and0x1215008. This rejects the possibility that the mapping is merely a shared stack-probe prefix.

abi_reviews.name: FLPROJ_LOAD_SLOT
observations: 0xf43b6f/0xf43b76/0xf43b7d capture self RCX, path RDX, flags R8B.
0xf43ba6..0xf43bb3 classifies against eight filename extensions; 0xf43bd2 tests flag bit0 before the save-changes virtual call.
Initial reference signature does not match because register saves and local-string bookkeeping differ. The incoming arguments, extension classifier and save-prompt logic agree.

abi_reviews.name: PATOP_SPLIT_SLOT
observations: 0xf42bef/0xf42bf3 capture RDX open-array pointer and R8 bound; self RCX is unused.
0xf42c57..0xf42cb5 iterates the pattern numbers backward, invoking per-pattern split helper 0x1192550 at 0xf42c9f, then refreshes patterns and playlist.
Reference 0xdc1da0 has the same argument roles and per-pattern split loop but differs in prompt helper and helper-result handling. Return values and cancel behavior require runtime coverage.

abi_reviews.name: other_pattern_slots
observations: Clone, delete, rearrange, edit and insert have unique level-one reference prefix matches within the TFLProject VMT.
Clone and delete capture RDX array and R8 bound; rearrange captures RDX/R8/R9D at 0xf417bf..0xf417c7.
Edit captures RCX/RDX/R8/R9D at 0xf42092..0xf4209e. Insert captures a single EDX pattern index at0xf415a9.

reference_wrapper_behavior: If form+0xc40 is nonnull, call grid helper0xd90e60 with that pointer, then no-argument helper0x11d2a90.
If form+0xd04 is nonnull, call grid helper0xd90e60 with that pointer.
observations: Both unique reference caller matches contain the same reference form-wrapper behavior inline, using target PR_GRID0xc00 and PL_GRID0xcb8.
Neighboring reference functions0xd45d50 and0xd45dd0 map to adjacent target functions0xce0c80 and0xce0cc0, with no intervening standalone wrapper.
Calling target_grid_helper with a form is incorrect: its RCX argument must be a grid.
playlist_refresh_adapter.integration_recommendation: Set exact24 PLREFRESH=0xd30840. In the exact24 local form adapter, use profile PR_GRID and PL_GRID offsets. If the piano grid is nonnull, call PLREFRESH(grid), then exact24 no-argument helper0x118a8c0; if the playlist grid is nonnull, call PLREFRESH(grid). Preserve existing function dispatch for other builds.
playlist_refresh_adapter.candidate_profile_semantics: On exact24.2.2.4597 only, PLREFRESH stores the grid invalidator address. The engine local adapter retains the form-taking external contract; other builds keep the original form wrapper semantic.

observations: Prologue only saves callee-preserved registers and initializes locals; it does not capture RCX,RDX,R8 or R9.
At0x118a8e0 it overwrites ECX with the current-pattern global before its first call0x118a8e6.
At0x118a8ed..0x118a8f7 it loads mapped CHANLIST itself and gets count; the subsequent loop resolves each channel at0x118a92c and refreshes its UI objects.
The independent inline caller sequences invoke it immediately after the one-argument grid invalidator, with no argument setup.

notes.coverage: Element width, array addressing and insertion reviewed. Complete bit-level semantic identity, selection handling and persisted-note behavior still need runtime tests.

common_prefix.proof: Same base note-array copy/add and clip defaults; array holders+0x14/+0x1c unchanged. ID+0x20 regenerated natively.
common_prefix.ownership: FL24 RTTI TPLEvent at0xe9aa70: size60 and0 managed fields. TPLFades at0xe9aa48: size24 and0 managed fields. TNoteEvent at0xe9a780: size24 and0 managed fields. Common prefix contains no Delphi managed references. Native purge removes external association by scalar ID+0x20; add replaces thatID.

clips.upconvert: Copy60 common bytes; append native FL25 defaults exactly.
clips.downconvert: Refuse the entire operation before any FL mutation if any appended20 bytes differ from defaults; otherwise copy the common60 bytes.
clips.caution: Defaults/dataflow support this candidate conversion, but whole common-prefix semantic identity and all new-field meanings are not exhaustively established. FL25 field+0x4c participates in additional processing lookup; default-only downconversion avoids importing that association intoFL24. Do not claim full mixed-runtime support before testing.

markers.coverage: RTTI proves only the name is managed. Marker add and published time-signature editor corroborate common fixed fields; every scalar-tail subtype not yet exercised.

arrangement.coverage: Constructor and track setter agree for these fields. Other arrangement/editor offsets are outside this focused report.

rec.mapping: For valid canonical mixer/effect IDs in[0x70000000,0x90000000), local_id=canonical_id-0x50000000. Keep channel IDs and values unchanged.
exclusions: Pseudo mute IDs0xf0000000 are client-only; handle them before translation.
REC_NONE0xffffffff is a return sentinel, never a target parameter.
Do not translate FL24 global controls0x40000000/01/02/05 or unknown namespaces.
Use unsigned arithmetic; reject unsupported canonical tracks instead of wrapping.
rec.integration: Apply mapping only at the two g_rec calls in engine read_value/write_value. All caches, hashes and wire IDs remain canonical; there is currently no g_rec hook or physical-ID input requiring reverse conversion.

unavailable_result.integration: Normalize both getter and setter results to canonical REC_NONE only for exact 24.2.2.4597
unavailable_result.method: Offline Capstone instructions from each exact SHA-256-bound PE; not Ghidra decompilation

bounds.observation: Native effect lookup indexes the decoded slot without a local slot bound in the reviewed branch
bounds.integration: Reject canonical tracks outside mix_count and slots 10..63 before native getter/setter, inbound routing or retry

limitations: Static findings do not attest runtime compatibility.
Proprietary binaries and raw decompiler output remain outside the repository.
